capabilities: Syncs TickTick projects, tasks, and habits into Obsidian
Renders Today, Habits, weekly planner, and project board views
Binds Markdown tasks to TickTick with preview-then-apply sync
Imports TickTick Notes one-way into a managed folder
Keeps recoverable snapshots, reports, and journals under .ticktick/
extras: README is bilingual (English and Persian). The API token stays in plugin settings and is never written to Markdown, snapshots, or reports; ambiguous creates are quarantined, and habit creation, checklist editing, and board dragging stay disabled until official TickTick API behavior is verified.
intentEvidence: هستهٔ مستقل برای اتصال امن Obsidian به TickTick، بدون وابستگی به TickTickSync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view, complete, or manage TickTick projects, tasks, and habits inside the vault.

relations.evidence: It syncs TickTick projects, tasks, and habits without bundling any account token or personal data.
هستهٔ مستقل برای اتصال امن Obsidian به TickTick، بدون وابستگی به TickTickSync.

summary: Standalone TickTick bridge that syncs projects, tasks, and habits into Obsidian views, inline code blocks, and a weekly planner.
